# Launch and Operations Checklist: Launch the new doncoleman.ca

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of the cutover, rollback, mail continuity, indexing, crawler and irreversible-retirement requirements before implementation
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command. It tests whether requirements are well written, not whether the implementation works. Items are for the PR reviewer.

## DNS Cutover Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Are the exact record fields to capture before the switch (type, name, value, proxy, TTL) specified, including where the recording is stored? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK002 Is "leaving every other DNS record unchanged" backed by a defined comparison method and baseline for non-mail records (not only mail)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for the apex and `www` being switched in a particular order, and for the state if only one of the two succeeds? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK004 Is "permanently redirects, keeping the path" specified for query strings, trailing slashes and HTTP-to-HTTPS combinations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010a]
- [ ] CHK005 Are "pending" versus "Problem:" thresholds for DNS propagation and certificate issuance quantified (how long pending may last before it becomes a failure)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the method for deciding "deliberately switched" versus "Ghost" versus "misconfigured" defined so a broken DNS state is not mistaken for a deliberate switch? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the TTL or cache lifetime of the Ghost records addressed so that rollback speed is predictable? [Gap, Spec §SC-005]

## Rollback Requirements

- [ ] CHK008 Is the rollback trigger defined (what symptoms justify rolling back, and who decides)? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK009 Can "under 15 minutes of his own work" be objectively measured, and does it explicitly exclude propagation time? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK010 Are rollback requirements defined for removing the Custom Domain and `www` redirect rule, not only restoring the Ghost records? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK011 Is setup check behaviour specified during a rollback (phase detection, post-launch items reporting, item 6 reporting Ghost again)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK012 Is rollback specified for the case where the review address has already been removed (FR-019a) before a late problem is found? [Conflict, Spec §FR-019a, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the ordering between removing `new.doncoleman.ca` and the end of the usable rollback window stated, so the review address is not removed before rollback confidence exists? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the 2-week window requirements consistent between Clarifications, FR-011, FR-021 and Assumptions, including when the 2 weeks start counting? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the state of search engine indexing after a rollback (noindex, canonical, cached pages) addressed? [Gap, Exception Flow]

## Mail Continuity

- [ ] CHK016 Is "mail records unchanged" defined precisely (record types, names, ordering, TTL, priority values) and is the baseline's source of truth identified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the Mailgun records to delete enumerated unambiguously (names and values) and distinguished from the iCloud records in the same zone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK018 Is a mail send and receive confirmation (not only a record comparison) required before and after the switch and after the Mailgun deletion? [Gap, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK019 Is it validated that nothing beyond Ghost's newsletter (other senders, the contact notification path) depends on the Mailgun records before deletion? [Assumption, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the sequence "cancel Ghost, delete Mailgun records, update baseline" specified so the baseline update and the DNS deletion cannot drift apart? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024]

## Indexing and Canonical Origin

- [ ] CHK021 Is "indexable after launch, previews not" specified for every preview surface (workers.dev aliases, per-commit URLs, review address) and for both header and meta signals? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK022 Are the places the main origin must appear (canonical, Open Graph, sitemap, `robots.txt`, RSS) enumerated and consistent between FR-010a and the plan's origin table? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010a]
- [ ] CHK023 Is deploy ordering relative to the switch specified so the live domain never serves the old noindex or the `new.doncoleman.ca` origin? [Gap, Dependency]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the requirement that Ghost-only addresses return the site's not-found page measurable (status code, page, which address classes)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the decision not to redirect old Ghost post addresses justified against expected inbound traffic loss, with an accepted-risk statement? [Assumption, Spec §FR-019]

## Sitemap and Internal Link Crawler

- [ ] CHK026 Is "a page" defined for the crawler (accepted status codes, treatment of redirects, content type) consistently between the edge case and FR-001? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK027 Are the crawl's link sources specified (anchors only, or images, stylesheets, fragments, feeds, `mailto:`), and how are fragment targets treated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements defined for the crawler being unable to run (preview not ready, build check missing, network error) so it fails closed? [Coverage, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the output format for naming the broken target and the linking page specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK030 Are time bounds for the crawl stated as a measurable limit rather than a plan estimate only? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the placeholder-copy readiness check defined precisely (phrases, content scope, case sensitivity, how a project is "marked as a placeholder")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003a]

## Irreversible Retirement Steps

- [ ] CHK032 Is each irreversible step (Ghost cancel, Supabase delete, Mailgun delete, repo archive) labelled irreversible with its prerequisite evidence stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, §FR-022, §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK033 Are the export artifacts defined (names, storage location, how "exists and is non-empty" is confirmed, and that they are not committed)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the Supabase project identity confirmation defined with concrete identifying criteria rather than "confirm it is Flux"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the point after which Ghost data cannot be recovered stated before the cancellation step, including the billing renewal date relative to the 2-week window? [Gap, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK036 Are retirement requirements consistent with being documented now but executed later, including who updates the baseline and `design-source.md` and in which follow-up change? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK037 Are cost impacts of retirement and of the new CI step stated against the $13 monthly ceiling? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions]

## Walkthrough Quality

- [ ] CHK038 Is every walkthrough step required to carry a pause marker, a what/where/confirm triple, and a stated outcome when the confirmation fails? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK039 Is the boundary between agent actions and Don-only actions stated for every step that touches DNS, accounts or exports? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK040 Is "the walkthrough MUST NOT proceed while any readiness item is not confirmed" enforceable through a defined mechanism rather than a statement of intent? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004]
